complete.description: True only when the review ran and every applicable item was walked over everything in scope.

excluded.description: Changed files left out on purpose, by --files or as generated.

detail.description: What is wrong and the concrete case that goes wrong.

evidence.description: The evidence that settles the finding.

file.description: Repository-relative path, or PR body for a finding in the pull request description.

line.description: 1-indexed line the finding anchors to, or null for a whole file, a deleted file or the pull request body.

severity.description: important or nit, as step 6 of the skill defines them.

title.description: Starts with the checklist item's name.

not_reviewed.description: What the review should have covered and did not, with the reason for each.

report.description: The plain-text report that step 7 of the skill prints after the JSON.

reviewed.description: The scope as a range: the --range as given, or <merge-base>..working-tree.

unverified.description: Each check that was not run, with the command that would settle it.
